First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: leisurely. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @dcbikeparty the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the DC Bike Party group ride

A free monthly group ride through the streets of DC with hundreds of riders, music and a theme. Start location changes and is posted on social media before each ride. All bikes and riders welcome.
